aggregation_definitions.equal_problem: Each declared problem in the stated population has equal weight.
aggregation_definitions.interpretation: Exact finite-model expectations; structural groups and repeated prior/policy conditions are not independent sampled incidents.
aggregation_definitions.ratios: Mean of per-problem cost/matched-optimum ratios, never ratio of means. Zero optima excluded explicitly; apply the declared weighting again within the positive-optimum population. Unknown optimum or missing eligible cost makes the mean unavailable.
aggregation_definitions.structure_balanced: Mean within each supplied structure group, then equal mean across groups in the stated population.
aggregation_definitions.unavailable: Missing grid rows fail closed. Explicit unavailable computations retain their problem weights; affected full means are null with missing IDs and observed weight shown.
